name: Zipz Dairy-Free Dole Whip Soft-Serve Cup (Bear Lake Raspberry Shake Swap)
searchKeywords: bear lake dairy free ice cream
whyItWorks: While everyone else gets a seeded, high-lactose Bear Lake raspberry shake, Zipz serves 100% dairy-free, seedless, fat-free Dole Whip soft-serve.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a plain Dole Whip cup (not swirled with dairy vanilla soft-serve unless taking a Lactaid) for a zero-seed, zero-lactose Bear Lake treat.
watchOuts: Confirm flavor of the day is citrus-free (e.g., pineapple/mango vs lime/orange)
